asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.74: route videos are now rendered on the device only when the user taps Create video on a ride; the finished video plays in the app and can be saved to Photos or shared. Videos are not uploaded or stored on our servers. The automatic background rendering, the My Videos tab and the optional tip jar were removed, so the app has no in-app purchases. New: Profile > Language lets the user pick the app language. Sign in with Apple to test.
